title: Pet-Friendly East Nash | 7 Min to Broadway
description:
Pet Friendly in East Nashville. 7 minutes to Broadway. Full kitchen. Plenty of parking.

This stylish home has a large, fully fenced backyard perfect for your pups to run free or the group to unwind after a night out. Guests love it.

Great base for Titans games, CMA Fest, and bachelorette weekends.

Close to Nissan Stadium, Ascend Amphitheater, The Basement East, and Attaboy. Whether you're here for a concert weekend, a group getaway, or soaking up Music City, this is your base camp.

The space
The space is a 3 Bedroom 2 Bath Craftman home originally built in the late 1940s.  In 2021 it underwent a full renovation to add all the modern touches you would expect in a new home.  With granite countertops, Hardwood floors throughout, a brand new dream kitchen, and an oversized shower in the primary bathroom this house will exceed your expectations, and have you never wanting to go home.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire house.

Other things to note
Your pets are welcome here! The pet fee is $75 per stay for up to two pets. Have more than two? 

Just message me before booking for approval at $75 per additional pet.

A couple of things to keep in mind: pets should be crated when you're away from the house, and we ask that they're not left unattended in the backyard

Neighborhood Info
You'll be staying on a wonderful, quiet street in a vibrant East Nashville neighborhood. Like any city, we recommend standard precautions — lock your car and keep valuables out of sight. The neighbors are friendly and the street has a great community feel.
